challenge.title: Why Farms Fail to Thrive
challenge.desc: Traditional farming lacks accessible data-driven tools. NutriPalm AI bridges this critical gap.
challenge.problem1_desc: Region-wide guidelines that ignore plot-specific soil conditions, leading to nutrient imbalances and wasted capital.
challenge.problem2_desc: Complex laboratory reports filled with raw chemical values and abbreviations that are impossible for growers to decipher.
challenge.problem3_desc: Vital field logs, historic yields, and previous NPK inputs are scattered across papers or completely forgotten.
challenge.problem4_desc: Growers manage water levels and fertilizer applications based on intuition rather than empirical agronomic metrics.

about.title: About Samruddhi Organics
about.p1: Samruddhi Organics is an AgriTech startup focused on improving farm productivity through scientific soil analysis, customized nutrient recommendations, precision agriculture, and sustainable farming practices.
about.p2: Our mission is to make data-driven agriculture simple, affordable, and accessible for every farmer.
about.ms1_desc: Directly onboarded and guided growers across Dakshina Kannada, tailoring practices to their specific local environments.
about.ms2_desc: Built fertilizer plans grounded in laboratory chemistry analysis rather than regional guesswork.
about.ms3_desc: Developed custom arecanut and crop nutrition recipes, balancing fertilizer applications and boosting yields.
about.ms4_desc: Amassed deep field expertise in soil chemistry dynamics, water absorption capacities, and micro-nutrient profiles.
journey.title: Our Journey
journey.subtitle: Trace the developmental milestone milestones of Samruddhi Organics, mapping agronomic research into software execution.
journey.p1_desc: Conducted initial agronomic analysis of Arecanut cropping patterns and NPK soil depletion models.
journey.p2_desc: Directly interviewed 50+ regional growers to catalog fertilization schedules and field records.
journey.p3_desc: Identified core pain points: region-wide generic suggestions and unintelligible chemistry lab sheets.
journey.p4_desc: Defined functional templates for building plot-level digital profiles and NPK recommendation scripts.
journey.p5_desc: Built the interactive digital twin prototype and custom chart telemetry console.
journey.p6_desc: Presenting the verified software mockup to the Incubation Centre to secure initial seed funding.
roadmap.title: Future Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Our product scaling direction, expanding from core recommendation Twins to full geospatial automated diagnostics.
roadmap.r1_desc: Our neural NPK prescription recommendation models mapping soil cores to fertilizer recipes.
roadmap.r2_desc: Calculate harvest weight forecasts based on current NDVI indices and moisture trends.
roadmap.r3_desc: Integrate high-revisit multi-spectral satellite telemetry to scan canopy biomass.
roadmap.r4_desc: Connect local micro-climate forecast nodes to alert growers of frost and heavy rain anomalies.
roadmap.r5_desc: Enable mobile camera scanning of crop leaves to analyze visual chlorophyll health.
roadmap.r6_desc: Deploy neural networks trained to scan leaf spotting and rust indices before spreading.
roadmap.r7_desc: In-field telemetry nodes measuring nitrogen diffusion and volumetric water content real-time.
roadmap.r8_desc: Orchestrate automated thermal mapping sweeps for large-scale operations.
demo.dashboard_desc: NutriPalm AI aggregates real-time agricultural vital stats, local weather forecasts, active operation logs, and AI observation metrics in a centralized SaaS dashboard.
demo.farmers_desc: Enables lead agronomists to list, search, village filter, and register new landholder profiles to coordinate custom agricultural advisory deployments.
demo.plots_desc: Leverages Sentinel-2 satellite coordinate mapping. Clicking on any custom plot instantly measures acreage, leaf NDVI health, and GNSS vertex node coordinates.
demo.twin_desc: An isometric canopy twin model tracking chlorophyll reflectance and root moisture. Toggling drought sandboxes automatically recalibrates vital indices in real-time.
demo.soil_desc: Agronomists upload diagnostic lab reports to trigger an OCR processing pipeline. Text extraction logs map Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Carbon and pH levels.
demo.recommendations_desc: Generates bespoke slow-release recipes (12-6-22 NPK). Calibrates seasonal timeline schedules, expected bunch weight gains (+18.2%), and environmental leaching risks.
demo.analytics_desc: Aggregates historical soil recovery graphs, active fertilizer volumes applied, and doughnut charts tracking regional crop type distribution metrics.

workflow.title: How NutriPalm AI Works
workflow.description: Our step-by-step digital process guides growers from registration all the way to precision dashboard analytics.
workflow.steps.0.title: Register Farmer
workflow.steps.0.desc: Onboard the grower by registering regional coordinate indexes, farm size, and harvest records.
workflow.steps.1.title: Create Farm Plot
workflow.steps.1.desc: Input coordinates or draw boundary lines to map exactly where crops will grow.
workflow.steps.2.title: Generate Digital Twin
workflow.steps.2.desc: Overlay historical moisture models, slope elevations, and NDVI biomass sensors into a virtual replica.
workflow.steps.3.title: Upload Soil Report
workflow.steps.3.desc: Feed organic soil chemistry values (nitrogen, organic carbon, moisture levels, acidity pH) to our analyzer.
workflow.steps.4.title: AI Analysis
workflow.steps.4.desc: Compare soil metrics against thousands of regional matrices to identify chemical bottlenecks and soil depletion.
workflow.steps.5.title: Receive Personalized Recommendation
workflow.steps.5.desc: Access detailed fertilizer schedules, soil correction steps, and crop rotation advisories tailored for Dakshina Kannada.
workflow.steps.6.title: Farm Dashboard
workflow.steps.6.desc: Open the console to monitor real-time weather feeds, NDVI moisture indexes, and upcoming yield alerts.
